meta.title: Wemuste — side jobs near you, on the map
meta.description: Find side jobs and full-time work near you. Verified employers only, and your profile is never public.

landing.headline: Side jobs near you, on the map.
landing.subhead: Browse real jobs from verified employers around the UAE. Tap one, send a request, get hired.
landing.step2: Tap a job on the map
landing.trustLine: Your profile is never public. Employers are checked by our team.
landing.mapAlt: Map of Dubai with job pins

authShell.trust2: Every employer is checked by our team
authShell.trust3: You choose which jobs to request

reset.subtitle: You'll be logged out on all devices after the change.

account.title: Account
account.deleteBody: This permanently deletes your profile, answers, videos, CV and requests. It can't be undone.
account.employerDeleteBody: This permanently deletes your company account, your jobs and their requests. It can't be undone.

apply.title: Apply
apply.leaveConfirm: Leave now? Your progress is saved on this device for 24 hours.

apply.introVideo: Record short video answers with your phone camera
apply.introSurvey: Your contact details and a few questions
apply.testIntro: {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}}. Answer honestly; there are no trick questions.

apply.noCamera: This browser can't record video. Please open this page in Chrome or Safari on your phone.
